row.title: Deploy What Works: Worker, D1 and route in the topology
row.body: Rowan approved the deploy (2026-11-25). D1 ultrastable-what-works (c915e72c) created in the ultrastable account; Worker ultrastable-what-works builds from instances/what-works/worker while the tenant is moving to ultrastable/what-works; cron 17 * * * *; route what-works.ultrastable.org; clock what-works-beat with a /pulse/watch restart route; loop what-works-beat owned by the Worker.

title: Deploy What Works: Worker, D1 and route in the topology
